stock.description: Established in 1997 and headquartered in Hangzhou, People's Republic of China, Zhong An Group Limited operates as a diverse conglomerate, primarily focusing on property development, real estate leasing, and hospitality management across Mainland China and Canada. The company's core operations are divided into two main segments: Residential, which is dedicated to the development, sale, and comprehensive management of residential properties; and Commercial, which involves the development, sale, and leasing of commercial properties, alongside the ownership and operation of hotels, complemented by property and project management services. Beyond its real estate and hospitality ventures, Zhong An Group holds interests in a broad spectrum of industries, including theater, tourism, finance, asset management, healthcare, securities management, and engages in the development of education, agriculture, and technology, as well as energy investments. Furthermore, the company provides specialized services such as construction design, shipping logistics, and corporate financial advisory. The organization adopted its current name, Zhong An Group Limited, in June 2019, having previously been known as Zhong An Real Estate Limited.
